name: RadioAtlas - Explore the world through music

ios.desc:
Explore the world through music with RadioAtlas! Listen to live, streaming radio stations from around the world for free!

- Scroll around the RadioAtlas map - find, select and listen to radio stations from all around the world
- Listen to a variety of free streaming global radio stations
- Save your favorite stations and stream them right from your phone any time
- Continue listening to your favorite station while using other apps
- Get local times in cities for current stations
- New stations added all the time!

quotes.text: This is awesome! I'm a mobile developer and I built an app similar in concept for iPhone a few months ago (except mine is way less robust and has wayyy fewer stations). Good work guys! Link to the app I built RadioAtlas: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/radioatlas-explore-world-through/id1141789251?mt=8
quotes.story_title: Radio Garden – Listen to world radio by navigating an interactive globe
